lines: Transforming metal within his range of vision at will――That was Tekkain Bantetsu's Evil Eye power, “Smith of Heaven”.
There were, broadly speaking, two ways of using it.
One was to wield the metal he owned―his cane—like a whip that changed form freely, or use it as a spear that could extend and retract endlessly.
And one other...
There were not many people who went out on the field of battle without carrying a weapon.
Swords, guns, armour, vehicles, telecommunications equipment――All the metal of those things the enemy carried became Bantetsu's tools.
He would transform them into blades and cut off their owners' heads, or deform their mail armour to crush their organs.
That was the reason why Bantetsu could be called the “natural enemy” of a cyborg――someone who had embedded metal in their body.
Amane
（Indeed――As long as he has his Evil Eye, I can't use my left arm――）
Amane's cyborgized left arm was furnished with an energy discharge port.
It was for releasing the powerful energy stored within her body through “Disruption Cycle” as a beam.
However, this had been targeted by Bantetsu in their last fight.
For the brief moment that she reversed the energy to fire it as a beam, Amane would be defenceless.
Because the invincible defence created by “Disruption Cycle”―the absorption of attack energy―would cease.
Aiming for that, her cyborg arm had been heavily damaged by a mere instant of metal transformation.
And it had resulted in Amane herself sustaining serious wounds, and running away to that hidden mansion.
Amane
（In which case――!!!!）
Amane
「HAAAAAAAAAAHHH!!!」
Bantetsu
「Hyo?」
She stepped forward, as if shaking off the severe pain all across her body.
Bantetsu
「Hmph, you're going to try to take me down with martial arts alone? You never learn――」
Amane
Amane's full-force kick hurtled through the air and missed.
He had abnormal lightness of body that made it hard to believe he was an elderly man.
And at the same time, Bantetsu's cane, which altered metal, became a sharp 『spear』 and attacked her.
Amane
「Aguuuuuh?!!」
Face, chest, side, thighs――
Serious damage, from which, ordinarily, it wouldn't even be strange for her to die instantaneously.
However, Amane had “Disruption Cycle”, which absorbed attack energy.
She could even withstand this damage.
Bantetsu
「Hmm? However――I've heard there is a limit to your Evil Eye, is there not?」
Amane
The old man displayed a sinister smirk to Amane, who stiffened up.
Bantetsu
「These three or four days――Why do you think I leisurely set my foot soldiers after you?」
Amane
There was a limit to the energy that “Disruption Cycle” could absorb.
And, once she exceeded the tolerable amount, her own body would be consumed by it.
――These past few days.
Amane had continued to be hounded by Bantetsu's followers.
Even small damage would become enormous if it built up.
And her cyborg arm, which was her greatest means to release that energy, had been put out of action――
Even Amane herself could no longer tell how close her own body was to the limit.
Bantetsu
「――Now, butler of Danjou. How much more do I have to thrust before that “membrane” of yours breaks?」
Amane
「h?!! You lowlife――!!!」
She howled, her hand poised to jab like a spear.
Amane and Bantetsu's martial arts were about equal.
In which case, Amane, who was currently heavily wounded, was at a disadvantage.
Bantetsu
「Hyo hyo hyo♪ Well then, shall I have you amuse me?」
Amane
Amane
「Uguh?! Guuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuh!!!!」
His 『spear』 obstructed her entire field of vision.
It was an abnormal series of attacks.
There was no damage.
However, something in the depths of her body began to creak every time “Disruption Cycle” absorbed an attack.
Amane
「Gaaaaaaaaaaaahhhh!!!」
She dodged the downpour of 『spears』, and stepped forward.
However, even that desperate resistance was thwarted, and even more continuous attacks assailed Amane.
Bantetsu
「Hyo hyo♪ There's much more to come♪」
Amane
（Aguuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuhhh?!!!）
The creaking of her body increased to an unbearable level.
Blood was sent from her heart, to her brain, and then to her eyeballs, with practically explosive force.
And then, at last――“Disruption Cycle's” defence was breached.
Amane
「Guuuh!!」
Violent pain assailed her abdomen.
Bantetsu's 『spear』 was sticking deep into Amane's side.
Amane
「Aguh...... Gah, hahah.........」
Fresh blood rose up from her stomach to her mouth.
Unable to remain standing at all, Amane crumpled to her knees on the ground.
Bantetsu
「Hyo hyo♪ Most pathetic, to get worn out from this little when you're so young.」
Amane
Bantetsu
「Hyo?」
He cocked his head at her low murmur.
Amane had made her eyes gleam at Bantetsu.
Amane
「Now, it's going “according to plan”, you old monster!!!」
She yelled, and forcefully spat the fresh blood that had flooded the inside of her mouth at him.
At the same time, she slid out the 『spear』 that had stabbed her by deliberately falling over.
Bantetsu
「Buh, buuh?! Cunning!! A blinding attack with clots of your blood?!」
Bantetsu sneered.
Both of his eyes were enhanced by UFS cyborg technology.
Even if she tried to obstruct his Evil Eye with her clotted blood, it was pointless.
Amane
「No, that's not it either. Getting blood on you is just a bonus. The real point is――」
Amane grinned.
Just before Fuuma Kotarou, who had had his abdomen impaled by Bantetsu, lost consciousness.
He had made her take hold of a small bag with sticky fluid in it.
Amane had put that in her mouth and spat it onto Bantetsu's face along with her fresh blood.
「――GAAAAAAAAAAHHH!!!!」
Bantetsu
An enormous figure sprang at him through the smoke.
Sharp claws were swung down, and Bantetsu's face was heavily gouged into.
Ninja Bear
「GARURURURURU!! GAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHH!!!!」
The contents of the small bag were the animal aphrodisiac that attracted nearby creatures and made them lose their senses.
The boy had secretly entrusted her with that stuff, which he had used to throw the rogue ninja into disarray.
To use as a trump card, to fend off the enemy who was an “Evil Eye user”.
Bantetsu
「Th-This damn bear's...?!」
Ninja Bear
Driven by anger, Bantetsu used his 『spear』.
But――in that moment, his Evil Eye veered away from Amane.
Bantetsu
His spine froze.
Amane
「......Apologize to Danjou-sama in hell, lowlife.」
She activated her left cyborg arm.
It had been damaged and out of action all this time, and was sure to be destroyed if she fired a single shot.
But that was fine.
If she did it at this precise moment, she wouldn't miss.
Amane
「Evil Eye: “Disruption Cycle”―――」
The discharge port on her left arm lit up, and a glaringly bright energy beam engulfed Bantetsu's body as he started to turn around.
Bantetsu
「GYAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHH!!」
For a moment, light flooded the smoke-filled forest, and then things soon returned to normal.
Amane
「Guuhh――」
Having released all her energy, Amane collapsed to the ground with a thud.
Amane
（Haha...... What an incredible boy my “Master” is......）
A smile spontaneously peeked out.
The ingenuity of the boy who “couldn't do anything” had saved her, and interred the leader of the Rogue Ninja Faction.
And, “I was able to protect him this time.”――
Amane spent a while savouring the feelings which flooded out from the depths of her heart.
Amane
（That said, I can't stay like this, can I?――）
The area was still in the midst of chaos.
There might be surviving ninja, and above all, the wounded Kotarou needed treatment.
She hurriedly turned around――and her face froze.
Amane
Bantetsu
「Hyo, hyo hyo...... You've done it now, fox woman...... I nearly crossed the River Styx.」
Bantetsu, who had had half his body blown away, was thrusting his cane at the unconscious boy's neck.
It was because he had cyborgized most of his body that Bantetsu, who was over 100, possessed abnormal physical ability.
Despite smoke smouldering from his skin, and reaching the point where he had lost half his body and become like a hunk of garbage, he was still just about alive.
Amane
（My aim was...... slightly off......）
Amane's eyes clouded over with despair.
She had intended to turn him into charcoal.
But because she had forcibly used her left arm, which was in the process of breaking, a slight deviation had occurred that was impossible to offset.
Amane
「Let the boy go, Bantetsu!!! Y-You bastaaarrrd!」
Bantetsu
「Whoops? Don't move, fox woman. Move, and your precious “Master” will have a hole in him.」
Bantetsu's cane transformed sharply.
A little blood trickled out from the boy's throat.
Amane
「―――h!!!! BANTETSUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUU!!!」
Amane bellowed, clawing at the ground. Having seen that, Bantetsu laughed, 「Hyo hyo!」
Bantetsu
「This brat has his uses――I did say that before, but right now, what I want to use him for is tormenting you.」
Bantetsu
「I'd like to slowly skin him right in front of you, or lop off his limbs one by one―― Hyahyahyahyahya!!!」
Amane
Bantetsu
「Hyo? What is this......?」
All of a sudden, as he laughed maniacally, a blade had sprouted from his stomach.
No, that wasn't a blade. It was someone's red-hot cyborg arm.
「―――Bantetsu, you are no longer one of us.」
Amane
Sagou Bungo.
A former confidant of Fuuma Danjou.
Like Amane and Bantetsu, a cyborg Taimanin who had defected to the UFS and continued to fight, even after Danjou's death.
But Sagou was a self-reliant man, who had not created a faction, like Bantetsu, but had chosen to fight all on his own.
Sagou
「Our enemies are the corrupt government, and the Gosha Taimanin who have become their dogs.」
Sagou
「Not that boy.」
Amane
He pulled his arm out, and the silent remains of Bantetsu tumbled to the grass.
Night was about to descend over the Gosha mountains, where their battle to the death had come to an end.
Present day.
Cheerful voices from the New Year's party were resounding out of the Fuuma residence.
Both
Four years had passed since that.
The wounded Amane had gone down to Gosha with the similarly wounded Fuuma Kotarou――
And, after a lengthy period of house arrest, had been forgiven by Igawa Asagi, and become his servant.
That was the birth of the “self-appointed” steward.
And Taimanin Library―Sagou Bungo—had, through a strange coincidence, also become the boy's guardian.
Amane
「Sagou. Are we disgraceful?」
Amane and Library had once had a master they had sworn to give their lives to protect.
But even after that master had died, the two of them had gone on living, like this.
Library
「I think we shall know that when our own lives come to an end.」
Amane
「Hmph. Without a doubt.」
She smiled.
――“Even the smallest of things can change the way a person lives.”
Back then, she had happened to meet that boy, and chosen to live along with him.
Whether that was right, she didn't know.
But, if she could smile like she was right now, then at the very least――
Kotarou
「Oooi!! Amane!! Library!!」
Kotarou
「We're all about to play karuta. You two come do it too!」
The bright voice of the young head of the Fuuma, calling for them both.
Amane
「――Understood, Young Lord!!」
Amane
「Fufu, well then. Shall we go――“Library”?」
Library
「Indeed.」
The two “comrades” softly smiled, and went back into the Fuuma residence.
